第1277章 生死攸关呐（第1页）
龟龟身周没有升腾任何寿元雾气，只能看到龟龟的那坚毅却逐渐有些衰老的面容。
饶是一向看龟龟不顺眼的张明、赵灵二人，都忍不住驻足侧目。
因为他们能感觉到，这一次跟以前不同，龟龟是真的不一样了！
但具体哪里不一样，最终结果怎么样……还得看具体情况。
龟龟偷奸耍滑欺上媚下的事情，可没少做。
它绝不能让玉女观的这几位，身死在这虚无之地。
论这天地之间，它可以说是最了解仙界遗老们的。
不给他们希望倒也罢了，给了希望又因为它的临阵脱逃而亲手破灭……
就连它那些个不论活着还是死去的红颜知己，与它有关的一切，都要被挫骨扬灰！
当然啦，经过这么多年的朝夕相处，它也的确融入了玉女观。
值此危难关头，龟龟绝不可能袖手旁观！
龟龟口中念念有词，容貌快速衰老，身周更是出现了从未出现过的大量死气。
纵是洛玉也呼吸一滞，那完美无瑕的玉颜之上满是动容。
此劫过后，得让东方鸢好好教教龟龟了。
这种危难关头还演戏，演给谁看呢？
只可惜，全身心投入卜卦中的龟龟，不会读心神通，更不知道洛师姐所想，否则定要请苍天辨忠奸。
伴随着龟龟一声怒吼，这方什么都不存在的‘虚无之地’，竟凭空出现了一道金光！

始一出现，便驱散了洛玉、张明、赵灵等人身上的一切不适。
金光迅速内敛，化作一只沐浴着神火的……金色麻雀？
麻雀站在龟龟的龟壳上，十分雀跃的转着脑袋，眼睛滴溜溜打量着四周，对周遭的一切都十分好奇。
她竟从金色麻雀身上，感知到了一丝令她浑身颤抖的恐惧感。
还是说，这麻雀蕴含了一丝天道意志？否则怎会在这虚无之地凭空出现！
张明更是怔怔看着龟壳灵宝，这乌龟小王八究竟什么来历，竟有这奇特手段？
龟龟有气无力道：“快，快带我们去寻找帝江的藏身处……”
麻雀叽叽喳喳叫着，似是在嘟囔什么。
龟龟急了，一边咳嗽一边虚弱大喊道：“生……生死攸关……咳，生死攸关呐！
金色麻雀的小眼睛中，明显流露出一丝人性化的嗤笑，这顿时给龟龟气的差点一口气没上来。
金色麻雀还是不情不愿的振翅，慢悠悠的飞了起来。
它身周所散发的金光，不仅指明了前进方向，更是为洛玉几人强行撑开了一个安全屏障。

Chapter 1277 A matter of life and death (page 1)
There was no longevity mist rising around Guigui, and only Guigui's resolute but gradually aging face could be seen.
Even Zhang Ming and Zhao Ling, who had always disliked Guigui, couldn't help but stop and look sideways.
Because they can feel that this time is different from before, Turtle is really different!
But what exactly is different and what the final result will be... it all depends on the specific situation.
Turtles often do things like cheating and cheating on their superiors and subordinates.
It will never let these people watched by Jade Girl die in this place of nothingness.
In this world, it can be said that it understands the immortals best.
It's fine if I didn't give them hope, but if I gave them hope, it would be dashed by my own hands because it escaped from the battlefield...
Even its confidantes, living or dead, and everything related to it will be crushed to ashes!
Of course, after so many years of getting along day and night, it has indeed integrated into the concept of jade girls.
At this critical moment, Turtle will never stand idly by!
Turtle was mumbling words, his appearance was aging rapidly, and a large amount of death energy that had never appeared around him appeared.
Even Luo Yu's breath was stagnant, and her flawless face was full of emotion.
After this calamity is over, Dongfang Yuan will have to teach Gui Gui a lesson.
If you are acting in such a critical moment, who should you act for?
It's a pity that Guigui, who devotes himself wholeheartedly to divination, doesn't know how to read minds, let alone know what Senior Sister Luo is thinking, otherwise he would have to ask the heaven to distinguish between loyal and traitorous people.
With the roar of Turtle, a golden light appeared out of thin air in this 'land of nothingness' where nothing existed!
As soon as Shi appeared, all the discomfort from Luo Yu, Zhang Ming, Zhao Ling and others was dispelled.
The golden light quickly restrained itself and turned into a... golden sparrow bathed in divine fire?
The sparrow stood on the turtle's shell, turning its head very happily, looking around with its eyes, very curious about everything around it.
She actually sensed a sense of fear from the golden sparrow that made her tremble all over.
Or does it mean that this sparrow contains a hint of heaven's will? Otherwise, how could it appear out of thin air in this place of nothingness!
Zhang Ming was even more stunned as he looked at the turtle shell spirit treasure. What was the origin of this little turtle tortoise, and how could he have such a strange method?
Turtle said feebly: "Quick, take us to find Di Jiang's hiding place..."
The sparrows were chirping, as if they were mumbling something.
Turtle became anxious, coughing and weakly shouting: "Life... life and death matter... cough, life and death matter!
There was a hint of human sneer clearly in the golden sparrow's small eyes, which made Turtle so angry that he almost lost his breath.
The golden sparrow still flapped its wings reluctantly and flew slowly.
The golden light emitted around it not only pointed out the direction of travel, but also forcibly opened a safety barrier for Luo Yu and the others.
